contrastSweep.scope: Rendered computed CSS colors against the actual opaque supporting surface for header, local scene text backings, each number window, each status and each state icon. No mixed foreground colors; no gradient or translucent supporting surface under these text groups.

rasterCorroboration.method: Compare normal render against same render with text made transparent; each torn digit uses its own text Range bounding rectangle within the rotated paper half (not the transparent label wrapper or the whole paper rectangle which can overlap the separate check icon); evaluate original computed foreground against underlying rendered RGB only at classified glyph pixels (>=8 channel difference, foreground-over-background coverage alpha0.025..1.02, maximum RGB compositing residual4). Every target must have visible classified glyph pixels; absent coverage fails. Tiny rendering differences that cannot result from the target glyph color are excluded and counted. Includes actual borders, snow, ornaments, SVG ticket and other compositing wherever beneath glyphs. Device scale1; no claim of a complete WCAG audit.
rasterCorroboration.starWorstCase: All 36 source stars forced to full individual opacity and full parent opacity (original fillOpacity retained) at every sampled time. Local text backings remain as designed. This exceeds normal night amount and peak twinkle brightness; the star style override is removed before deliverable screenshots.
